name: Numverify
label: Numverify
description: Numverify official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: validate. Docs: https://numverify.com/documentation. APILayer Numverify terms. HTTPS base https://apilayer.net/api (classic access_key query). Phone numbers are PII — do not log. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Numverify request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"validate"}.

schema.label: country_code
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 when number is national. Example: US.

schema.label: number
schema.description: Phone number to validate (E.164 or national with country_code). Example: 14158586273.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
